responsibility: This file provides the shared implementation of generic OpenMP/OpenACC utilities used across front ends and middle-end passes. It handles clause lookup and language-hook mediated queries about Fortran/OpenMP data-sharing semantics, canonicalizes and extracts loop-header information into omp_for_data for OMP_FOR lowering, maintains the global omp_requires mask, and implements common logic for declare variant/context handling, OpenACC routine attribute compatibility and dimension construction, offloading-function classification, and helpers for decoding OpenACC internal dimension operations.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable implementations for the generic OpenMP/OpenACC facilities declared in gcc/omp-general.h, such as clause lookup, loop-header extraction into omp_for_data, omp_requires state, declare-variant handling, and OpenACC routine/offload helpers. Unlike the header, it is not the shared type-and-declaration hub; it supplies the cross-module utility logic those declarations describe.
